example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় মুঘলাই কায়দায় চলাফেরা করে।
পার্টিতে তার মুঘলাই কায়দা সবাইকে অস্বস্তিকর করে তুলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always walks around with Mughal airs.
His ostentatious manner at the party made everyone uncomfortable.
history: This idiom draws from the lavish and elaborate customs of the Mughal Empire in India, which ruled Bengal from the 16th to 19th centuries, symbolizing royal extravagance.
note: The term evokes the grandeur of Mughal courts, often critiqued in colloquial Bengali for excessive showiness.
